description.html:
Provide your baby with our best AIRFLOW SKIN COMFORT, with Pampers Premium Care Nappies. Its 10 Million Micropores let fresh air in & humid air out, keeping baby's skin dry and protected. Its Wetness Indicator changes color from yellow to blue, to tell you it's time for a nappy change.

For our best Skin Comfort, don't forget to try Pampers Wipes to Help Wipe Away Dirt & Mess while gently cleaning baby's skin. Add to the cart now to make nappy changing easier and convenient!

1. Breathable material with 10 Million Micropores for Air to Flow freely

2. Ultra Absorb Core absorbs fast and locks wetness away from baby's skin

3. Built in Bum Lotion to help prevent Bum Rashx

4. Cotton-likex softness keeps baby's skin comfortable

5. Wetness indicator tells you when its time for a nappy change

xDoes not contain cotton

Available in these sizes - Size 0, Size 1, Size 2, Size 3, Size 4, Size 5, Size 6

Disclaimer : Product images are for illustrative purposes only and may differ from the actual product due to product updates and enhancements

What's in the box
1 x 120 Premium Care Nappies - Size 3

items.description:
## What does this mean?

You can pay for this item with cash when your driver delivers your order.

### How does it work?

Select Cash On Delivery (COD) as your payment option when you checkout.
Have the exact amount of cash ready for our friendly delivery driver when he arrives.

### Is COD available on every order?

No. We don’t offer COD for:

-   Digital products (e.g. eBooks, gift vouchers or airtime)
-   Customised products (e.g. a sports shirt printed with a personalised name)
-   Orders totalling less than R100 or more than R3,000
-   Orders being collected from Takealot pickup points
-   Delivery addresses falling outside of our Takealot Delivery Team area
-   Accounts that do not have a verified South African mobile number


### If your order is eligible for COD, it will be displayed as a payment option at checkout.
Limited warranty, with certain exclusions, as defined by the manufacturer. Please consult the manufacturer for further details.

### Free exchanges & returns for 30 days

Wrong size? Not quite what you wanted? You can exchange or return your purchase up to 30 days from the day you received it.

2. Prepare your return parcel.
3. Wait for courier collection or drop off the parcel yourself.
4. If approved, your account will be credited.
